blocks.text: Reference grammar A2

This part collects in tables everything you have studied in the units A2-01 → A2-23 and continue the numbering of the cards A1 (G1–G19). It does not replace the explanations of units: it is used to review, check a form while writing and preparing tests. The reference unit shall be indicated for each card. The marked forms are not required in the production of A2.
G20 · Root and scheme (A2-01)

The root is the series of consonants (usually three) that bears the basic meaning; the scheme is the vocal form, with any added letters, which bears the grammatical meaning. In the schemes the three consonants are indicated by ⁧ف ع ل⁩ .
⁧ـِيّ⁩ nisba (report adjective) ⁧عِلْمِيّ⁩ · ⁧مِصْرِيّ⁩ Egyptian · scientific

Find the root. 1. Remove article, attached prepositions and suffix pronouns ( ⁧الـ، بِـ، لِـ، وَ، ـهُ، ـهَا⁩ …). 2. Remove terminations ( ⁧ـَة، ـَات، ـُونَ، ـِينَ، ـَانِ⁩ ). 3. Remove the verbal prefixes ( ⁧أ، ت، ي، ن⁩ ) ⁧م⁩ initial participles and place names.
4. Remove the long vowels inserted in the diagram ( ⁧ا، و، ي⁩ ). 5. If two consonants remain, the root is doubled
( ⁧رَدّ⁩ → ⁧ر د د⁩ ) or weak ( ⁧قَالَ⁩ → ⁧ق و ل⁩ ; ⁧مَشَى⁩ → ⁧م ش ي⁩ ). In the dictionary by root you then look for the root and, below, the form.
G21 · The perfect (A2-02)

The vowel of the perfect. Three types: faʿala ( ⁧كَتَبَ⁩ , ⁧ذَهَبَ⁩ ), faʿila ( ⁧شَرِبَ⁩ , ⁧فَهِمَ⁩ , ⁧عَمِلَ⁩ ), faʿula ( ⁧كَبُرَ⁩ ). You learn with the verb. ⁧قَدْ⁩ / ⁧لَقَدْ⁩ + perfect underlines that the action is accomplished: ⁧قَدْ وَصَلَ القِطَارُ⁩ The train is (already) arrived. ⁧لَقَدْ نَجَحْتُ⁩ I did it. The weak verbs to the perfect are in G34, the doubled and the hammies in G35.
G22 · The imperfect (A2-03)

The voice of the imperfect. Three types: yafʿulu ( ⁧يَكْتُبُ⁩ , ⁧يَدْرُسُ⁩ ), yafʿilu ( ⁧يَجْلِسُ⁩ , ⁧يَعْرِفُ⁩ ), yafʿalu ( ⁧يَفْتَحُ⁩ , ⁧يَشْرَبُ⁩ , ⁧يَعْمَلُ⁩ ). In forms II, III and IV the prefix has the vowel u: ⁧يُدَرِّسُ⁩ , ⁧يُسَاعِدُ⁩ , ⁧يُرْسِلُ⁩ . Use. Current and usual ( ⁧يَعْمَلُ هُنَا⁩ This is where he works; after the fashion verbs ( ⁧يُمْكِنُ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧يَجِبُ أَنْ⁩ : G23); with ⁧كَانَ⁩ for the Italian imperfect (G)26).
G23 · Future and conjunctive (A2-04)

Future. ⁧سَـ⁩ (attacked) ⁧سَوْفَ⁩ (detached) + indicative flaw: ⁧سَأُسَافِرُ⁩ , ⁧سَوْفَ نَرَى⁩ . Denial: ⁧لَنْ⁩ + conjunctive: ⁧لَنْ أُسَافِرَ⁩ . The conjunctive (manṣūb) is formed by the indication: -u becomes -a; the shapes in -na / -ni lose the nūn (except -na of the female plural).
⁧أَنْ يَدْعُوَيَدْعُو⁩ ⁧يَنْسَى⁩ ⁧أَنْ يَنْسَى⁩

When you use it. After ⁧أَنْ⁩ (with verbs of will and possibility: ⁧يُرِيدُ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧يَجِبُ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧يُمْكِنُ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧يُحَاوِلُ أَنْ⁩ ); after ⁧لَنْ⁩ ; after ⁧لِـ⁩ , ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ , ⁧كَيْ⁩ , ⁧حَتَّى⁩ For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions apply: after ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ and ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ ( G33). The ⁧ـو⁩ of the plural takes a mute alif: ⁧أَنْ يَكْتُبُوا⁩ .
G24 · The jurissive and ⁧لَمْ⁩ ( A2-05)
The Jurissive (maǧzūm): -u becomes sukūn; the shapes in -na / -ni lose the nūn, like the conjunctiva.

In concave verbs the long vowel shortens before the sukūn ( ⁧يَقُولُ⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَقُلْ⁩ ); The final long vowel falls into the defects ( ⁧يَمْشِي⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَمْشِ⁩ ). Use. ⁧لَمْ⁩ + negative = negative past ( ⁧لَمْ أَذْهَبْ⁩ I did not go, more formal than ⁧مَا⁩ + perfect; ⁧لَا⁩ + legal = prohibition ( ⁧لَا تَنْسَ⁩ : G25); ⁧لَمَّا⁩ + juxtaposition not yet indicated; ⁧لِـ⁩ + Jussivo ...! ⁧لِيَدْخُلْ⁩ (i) if it enters, recognise).

G26 · ⁧كَانَ⁩ and his family (A2-07)

⁧كَانَ⁩ + predicate to the accused: ⁧كَانَ الجَوُّ جَمِيلًا⁩ The weather was beautiful. It conjugates as a concave verb (G34): ⁧كُنْتُ⁩ , ⁧كُنْتَ⁩ , ⁧كُنْتِ⁩ , ⁧كَانَ⁩ , ⁧كَانَتْ⁩ , ⁧كُنَّا⁩ , ⁧كُنْتُمْ⁩ , ⁧كَانُوا⁩ ; imperfect ⁧يَكُونُ⁩ ; Junior ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ⁩ ; future ⁧سَيَكُونُ⁩ ; conjunctive ⁧أَنْ يَكُونَ⁩ . ⁧كَانَ⁩ + imperfect = imperfect Italian (habitation, action in the past): ⁧كُنْتُ أَعْمَلُ فِي رُومَا⁩ I was working in Rome. ⁧كَانَ قَدْ⁩ + Perfect = Passed (G)38).
Everyone preaches to the accusative; with an imperfect one indicate a continuous action ( ⁧مَا زَالَ يَعْمَلُ⁩ It is still working.
G27 · The pluralities between the two sides (A2-08)

Diptotes. The patterns marked with the ḍamma final ( ⁧فُعَلَاءُ⁩ , ⁧أَفْعِلَاءُ⁩ , ⁧مَفَاعِلُ⁩ , ⁧مَفَاعِيلُ⁩ , ⁧فَوَاعِلُ⁩ , ⁧فَعَائِلُ⁩ ) do not take tanwīn and, if indeterminate, they have the genitive in -a: ⁧فِي مَكَاتِبَ كَثِيرَةٍ⁩ . With the article or in iḍāfa normally decline: ⁧فِي المَكَاتِبِ⁩ . Agreement. Plural of things or animals → adjective and singular female verb: ⁧الكُتُبُ جَدِيدَةٌ⁩ , ⁧الرَّسَائِلُ وَصَلَتْ⁩ . Plural of people → plural adjective: ⁧الطُّلَّابُ جُدُدٌ⁩ / ⁧جَدِيدُونَ⁩ .
G28 · L'iḍāfa and quantifyors (A2-09)

Chains. Only the last term may have the article; all terms after the first one are at the genitive; no time limit except the last one has the tanwīn: ⁧مُدِيرُ مَكْتَبِ الجَوَازَاتِ⁩ The Director of the Passport Office is hereby appointed. The adjective goes to the bottom and agrees with the name to which it refers: ⁧مُدِيرُ المَكْتَبِ الجَدِيدُ⁩ The new Director of the Office (Nominative, as ⁧مُدِيرُ⁩ ); ⁧مُدِيرُ المَكْتَبِ الجَدِيدِ⁩ The Director of the new office is:
⁧المَكْتَبِ⁩ ).

G29 · Suffixed pronouns on verbs and prepositions (A2-10)
⁧ـهُمَا⁩ · ⁧ـكُمَا⁩ ⁧سَاعَدَهُمَا⁩ ⁧مَعَهُمَا⁩ you two · the two of them

Rules. On the verb is always ⁧ـنِي⁩ ( nūn For protection): ⁧يُخْبِرُنِي⁩ . After i, ī o y, ⁧ـهُ⁩ becomes ⁧ـهِ⁩ and ⁧ـهُمْ⁩ becomes ⁧ـهِمْ⁩ : ⁧فِيهِ⁩ , ⁧عَلَيْهِمْ⁩ , ⁧بِهِ⁩ . After -tum the verb takes -ū-: ⁧رَأَيْتُمُوهُ⁩ . After -ū ( ⁧كَتَبُوا⁩ ) the silent alife falls: ⁧كَتَبُوهُ⁩ . With the prepositions: ⁧لِي⁩ , ⁧عَلَيَّ⁩ , ⁧إِلَيَّ⁩ , ⁧لَدَيَّ⁩ , ⁧مِنِّي⁩ , ⁧عَنِّي⁩ . ⁧لَدَى⁩ "Near', having any of the following (formal): ⁧لَدَيَّ سُؤَالٌ⁩ . ⁧إِيَّا⁩ + suffix carries the second object: ⁧أَعْطَيْتُكَ إِيَّاهُ⁩ I gave it to you (recognize).
G30 · Comparative and superlative (A2-11)

Construction. Comparative + ⁧مِنْ⁩ : ⁧القَاهِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مِيلَانُو⁩ . More than that: ⁧أَكْبَرُ بِكَثِيرٍ مِنْ⁩ . Superlative: ⁧أَفْعَلُ⁩ + Undetermined singular ( ⁧أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَةٍ⁩ The largest city () or plural ( ⁧أَكْبَرُ المُدُنِ⁩ ); or adjective with the article ( ⁧المَدِينَةُ الكُبْرَى⁩ ). Feminine ⁧فُعْلَى⁩ (Recognize): ⁧الكُبْرَى⁩ , ⁧الصُّغْرَى⁩ , ⁧الأُولَى⁩ , ⁧الوُسْطَى⁩ , ⁧العُظْمَى⁩ . ⁧أَفْعَلُ⁩ It's just... it's just...

G32 · The relative pronouns (A2-13)

Rules. 1. Its use is only after a given name; after an indeterminate name, the relative follows without pronoun: ⁧رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا يَبْكِي⁩ . 2. The pluralities of things take ⁧الَّتِي⁩ : ⁧الكُتُبُ الَّتِي قَرَأْتُهَا⁩ . 3. The resume pronoun is mandatory when its is not the subject: ⁧الكِتَابُ الَّذِي قَرَأْتُهُ⁩ , ⁧البَيْتُ الَّذِي أَسْكُنُ فِيهِ⁩ , ⁧الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي سُرِقَتْ سَيَّارَتُهُ⁩ . 4. Without prior: ⁧مَنْ⁩ • who for persons ( ⁧مَنْ يَدْرُسُ يَنْجَحُ⁩ ), ⁧مَا⁩ "What is meant by things" ( ⁧لَا أَفْهَمُ مَا تَقُولُ⁩ ;

Plural of defects: ⁧نَسُوا⁩ , ⁧مَشَوْا⁩ , ⁧دَعَوْا⁩ (perfect); ⁧يَنْسَوْنَ⁩ , ⁧يَمْشُونَ⁩ , ⁧يَدْعُونَ⁩ (Imperfect). Concave to the perfect: the long vowel shortens in front of a consonant desinence ( ⁧قَالَ⁩ → ⁧قُلْتُ⁩ , ⁧قُلْنَا⁩ ; ⁧كَانَ⁩ → ⁧كُنْتُ⁩ ). Assimilates: the ⁧و⁩ falls to the imperfect, the righteous and the imperative ( ⁧يَصِلُ⁩ , ⁧يَصِفُ⁩ , ⁧يَعِدُ⁩ ). ⁧جَاءَ⁩ Come on. ⁧جِئْتُ⁩ ; to the imperfect is usually used ⁧يَأْتِي⁩ ( ⁧لَمْ يَأْتِ⁩ ).
G35 · Doubled, hamed and hamza writing (A2-16)

Double up. The double remains united in front of a vowel and melts before a consonant desinence: ⁧رَدَّ⁩ → ⁧رَدَدْتُ⁩ , ⁧رَدَدْنَا⁩ ; imperfect ⁧يَرُدُّ⁩ ; juxtative and imperative ⁧لَمْ يَرُدَّ⁩ , ⁧رُدَّ⁩ . So ⁧مَرَّ⁩ , ⁧ظَنَّ⁩ ( ⁧ظَنَنْتُ⁩ ), ⁧اِسْتَمَرَّ⁩ , ⁧اِهْتَمَّ⁩ .
